findings.title: DMARC not enforced (p=none): domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud

evidence.excerpt: DMARC record: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@brightwaterfleet.example; policy=none, pct=100, rua=true

findings.deal_impact: Domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud against customers and deal counterparties; creates phishing and fraud risk and may affect insurability until enforcement is staged to reject.

remediation.summary: Monitor DMARC reports, align SPF/DKIM, then move policy via quarantine to p=reject.

findings.title: SPF uses soft/neutral fail

evidence.excerpt: SPF record: v=spf1 include:_spf.mailhost.example include:sendgrid.example ~all; qualifier=~all, lookup_count=2

findings.deal_impact: Softfail weakens sender authentication and increases successful spoofing/phishing likelihood alongside DMARC p=none, raising fraud risk for a fleet customer base.

remediation.summary: Inventory authorized senders, validate includes, then change SPF qualifier to -all.

findings.title: DNSSEC not enabled

evidence.excerpt: DNSSEC enabled=false for DS query on brightwaterfleet.example

findings.deal_impact: Unsigned DNS increases cache-poisoning/redirection risk; low standalone deal impact but a basic hygiene gap for diligence and cyber insurance questionnaires.

remediation.summary: Enable DNSSEC at registrar/zone provider and verify DS publication and validation.

findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems
findings.deal_impact: Public names suggest VPN, legacy CI, staging API and legacy portal attack surface; requires confirmatory diligence on exposure, patching and decommissioning before close.

remediation.summary: Validate ownership and exposure of risky hosts, restrict or decommission legacy/staging systems, and inventory VPN access.

findings.title: Large certificate footprint relative to company size

evidence.excerpt: Certificate Transparency query returned unique_hostnames=47, risky_hostnames_count=4

findings.deal_impact: 47 public hostnames for a 201-1000 employee company suggests asset sprawl that can hide unmanaged systems; modest value-creation cost to build an authoritative inventory.

remediation.summary: Reconcile CT hostnames to an authoritative asset inventory and remove or register orphaned hosts.

findings.title: Deprecated TLS versions offered

evidence.excerpt: tls_support TLSv1.0=true, TLSv1.1=true, TLSv1.2=true; tls_versions=[TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2]

findings.deal_impact: Deprecated TLS on www weakens transport security and can fail customer/PCI-adjacent security reviews; indicates inconsistent hardening versus the apex host.

remediation.summary: Disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 on www, enforce TLSv1.2+ with modern ciphers, and retest.

findings.title: HSTS not set
findings.deal_impact: Missing HSTS allows protocol downgrade on first visits; minor standalone risk but an easy hygiene item likely flagged in insurance and customer diligence.

remediation.summary: Set Strict-Transport-Security with an appropriate max-age on apex and www after confirming HTTPS coverage.

findings.title: Internet-facing appliance listed in CISA KEV (version not verified)

evidence.excerpt: KEV match CVE-PLACEHOLDER-0001, ExampleGate SSL-VPN 7.0.11, kind=appliance, match_tier=appliance_exposed, match_level=product; note: KEV lists products, not affected versions; version not verified. Snapshot 2026-10-20.

findings.deal_impact: Potential exposure to a known-exploited SSL-VPN appliance (version not verified) could allow network entry; treat as pre-close confirmatory item for patch level, MFA and logs before relying on criticality.

remediation.summary: Immediately verify ExampleGate version/patch against KEV CVE, patch or isolate appliance, enforce MFA and review access logs.

findings.title: Publicly disclosed security incident in the last 24 months

evidence.excerpt: State AG breach notice dated 2025-08-14: unauthorized access to a customer support system; approx. 3,100 individuals notified. Entity_match=exact; disclosed_within_months=14.

findings.deal_impact: Incident 14 months ago affecting ~3,100 individuals signals realized compromise and possible notification, regulatory and customer-trust costs; diligence should review root cause, remediation and open obligations.

remediation.summary: Obtain incident report, regulator correspondence and remediation evidence; confirm closure of root cause and notification obligations.
